note: symmetric even arch reads cleanest as a rainbow
clear head+antenna, arm, legs in right proportion
twin sails with visible mast is the most classic sailboat silhouette
clear shell, eye stalks, and elongated body read immediately as a snail
multiple articulated legs radiating from a central body read best as a spider
mantle with trailing tentacle legs and fin bumps reads clearly as squid
extruded top point and spreading arms/legs read best as a 3D star
hull with a clear conning tower/periscope is the most legible submarine
